description: Dual-mode voice input: takes over the OFFICIAL ZCode 3.18 mic button. Right-click it for a menu that switches between official cloud ASR (pass-through) and our local SenseVoice engine (audio never leaves the machine). Local mode adds realtime draft transcription, 3 recording skins, hotkey toggle, device picker, idle-exit and autoStart. Self-bootstrapping deps (npm tgz + model, sha256), sidecar runs on ZCode own Electron, lifecycle bound to the app.
